description: Java class PropFindHelper provides utility methods for handling WebDAV PROPFIND requests and responses within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating XML elements, parsing request documents, and checking request types related to WebDAV.

classes.name: PropFindHelper
classes.description: Helper class for WebDAV PROPFIND requests and responses, extending ResponseHelper, managing XML document parsing and creation.

methods.name: createPropElement
methods.description: Creates a <prop> XML element with a list of property elements.

methods.name: createPropStatElement
methods.description: Creates a <propstat> XML element containing a property and status.

methods.name: getFindPropsList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of property elements from the request document matching a namespace.

methods.name: isAllProp
methods.description: Checks if the request is for all properties (contains 'allprop').

methods.name: isPropName
methods.description: Checks if the request is for property names only (contains 'propname').
